To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of the Internet is a key factor for the development of the public communication of science and technology; (2) the use of social networks and the development of a culture of participation in the public communication of scientific and technological information are important factors for the development of public communication of science in the country; (3) the development of the Public Communication of Science and Technology (PCST) is a factor that influences the development of science and innovation in the country.
